AI-Mini-Drama-P23-01.title: Failed generations keep the credits already booked, with no refund
AI-Mini-Drama-P23-01.short: PDR-I 16.9.0 - [AIAgent] AI Mini Drama: Failed character and video generations keep their charged credits with no refund
AI-Mini-Drama-P23-01.desc:
Repro Steps:
1. Launch the APP
2. Tap AI Mini Drama on the Launcher
3. Tap History
4. Tap a drama whose characters are set (e.g. The Dog Who Remembered Her)
5. Read the balance on the credit pill
6. Tap Generate on a card whose generation fails (e.g. Create characters after asking to change Mia's look)
7. Wait for the failure message
8. Tap Back until the Launcher is shown
9. Tap Mine
10. Tap Credits
11. Tap Details
12. Check the result

Result:
Each failed generation keeps 1-12 credits (Text to Speech / Text to Image rows) and no refund row is added.
摘要：生成失敗後仍扣除 1–12 點（文字轉語音/文字轉圖片），且無退點紀錄。
{16.9.0_amd40_tc206_failed.jpg} {16.9.0_amd40_tc206_ledger.jpg} {16.9.0_amd40_tc137_card_says_refunded.jpg} {16.9.0_amd40_tc137_ledger.jpg} {16.9.0_amd40_video_failed.jpg} {16.9.0_amd40_video_ledger.jpg} {16.9.0_amd40_log.txt}

Expect Result:
A failed generation costs nothing: every credit it charged is returned with a refund row.
摘要：失敗的生成不應扣點：所有已扣點數都應退還並出現退點紀錄。
Spec string: 「We couldn't create this character. Your credits have been refunded. Try again.」

Note:
Device: iPhone 17 Air / iOS 26.2.1
Spec Link: AI Mini Drama PM spec, Error Handling board - https://www.figma.com/design/44RyrcOcWi2MvhGci9bO5F/AI-Mini-Drama?node-id=2016-2
Related: DRI261896P0042 (no refund notice on failed characters), DRI261896P0019 and DRI261897P0006 (the failures themselves)
<Claude Reviewed>
AI-Mini-Drama-P23-01.qa_note: Rule 8 (refund check) on three failures, each matched by time and amount in Mine › Credits › Details (shared account, other devices' rows excluded). (1) TC-206, template 「The Dog Who Remembered Her」 (Number 99): 「Create characters ◆8 · Generate」 for Mia's look edit 19:58:39 → 「Something went wrong on my end.」 at 19:59:06 (character-edit resolve_uri failure, already DRI261896P0019); pill 20192 → 20190 → 20190 after reopening; ledger 19:58 Text to Speech −1 and 19:59 Text to Speech −1, no 「Generation failed, credits returned」 row (ledger/TC-206-20261020-200226.json). (2) TC-137, Create my character with Pink Fail media tool = TextToImage: the card says 「We couldn't create this character and your credits have been refunded.」 but pill 19677 → 19676; ledger 2026-10-21 00:17 Text to Speech −1, no refund row (ledger/TC-137-20261021-002323.json); log: TextToImage failed at 00:17:17.034, the TTS step still ran and was allowed (credit=1) at 00:17:17.597. (3) O-15, video gate retry on 「ライバルの共闘」 (Preview 30 s ◆139): 'Video couldn't be created' after 402 s (storage PUT failure, DRI261897P0006); pill 19297 → 19285; ledger Text to Speech −1 ×3 at 05:17 and Text to Image −3 ×3 at 05:23 = −12, no AI Video Generator row and no refund row (ledger/GATE2-video-20261021-052722.json). One mechanism in all three: per-tool charges booked inside a turn that then fails are never returned, so the user pays 1–12 credits for nothing; the first gate (10/20 16:04) booked nothing and is not a case of it. P1 noted the TTS credit kept on failed characters inside the DRI261896P0042 recheck (that ticket is about the missing error/refund notice); this entry is the charge itself, raised separately per rule 8. Spec: R-036 (PM Error Handling) promises the refund on a failed character; R-080/R-084 for videos. Pink fault toggles were set back Off after TC-137.

AI-Mini-Drama-P23-02.title: X on Finish your characters keeps the generated looks
AI-Mini-Drama-P23-02.short: PDR-I 16.9.0 - [AIAgent] AI Mini Drama: X on Finish your characters keeps the generated looks instead of discarding them
AI-Mini-Drama-P23-02.desc:
Repro Steps:
1. Launch the APP
2. Tap AI Mini Drama on the Launcher
3. Tap Create Your Drama
4. Type a story idea with two characters
5. Tap Send
6. Tap Generate on the format card
7. Wait for Ready to create your characters
8. Tap a character slot
9. Tap the checkmark without choosing any look
10. Tap Generate all on Finish your characters
11. Wait for Your characters are ready
12. Tap X on the sheet without tapping Confirm
13. Check the result

Result:
The sheet closes but the new looks are already applied to the cast slots.
摘要：按 X 關閉後，新生成的造型仍已套用到角色欄位。
{16.9.0_amd41_ready.jpg} {16.9.0_amd41_after_x.jpg} {16.9.0_amd41_log.txt}

Expect Result:
X closes back to Choose Character and the generated looks are not applied to the slots.
摘要：按 X 應回到 Choose Character，新造型不應套用到角色欄位。

Note:
Device: iPhone 17 Air / iOS 26.2.1
Spec Link: AI Mini Drama Design spec, Characters: Flow, Create my character, Filter, Error board - https://www.figma.com/design/dZk5HLzZTdcZwWwvN9aZfZ/AI-Mini-Drama?node-id=2811-90144
<Claude Reviewed>
AI-Mini-Drama-P23-02.qa_note: Flow arrow 2811-90144 (Design Characters board): X on the Finish your characters sheet closes back to Choose Character and the generated looks are NOT applied. Storm and Shelter (David, Margaret unset) › ✓ › 「Generate all ◆8」 19:36:10 → 「Your characters are ready」 + Confirm after 120 s → X without Confirm: the sheet closes, but both slots already show the new looks and David's new 「✦ Mine」 card is checked in 「Choose for David」. The log explains it: the generation runs as a chat turn that ends 19:38:01 with 'turn end · stage=storyboard · card=none' — the looks are committed and the stage moved to storyboard before Confirm, so X has nothing to discard. The same turn produced the duplicate outline block of TC-208 (DRI261896P0024, still reproduces). The 8 credits were charged for looks that did succeed, so the charge is not the defect; the user just cannot reject them.

AI-Mini-Drama-P23-03.title: Character filter with no matches shows a blank grid
AI-Mini-Drama-P23-03.short: PDR-I 16.9.0 - [AIAgent][UX] AI Mini Drama: Character filter with no matches shows a blank grid with no empty state
AI-Mini-Drama-P23-03.desc:
Repro Steps:
1. Launch the APP
2. Tap AI Mini Drama on the Launcher
3. Tap History
4. Tap a drama whose cast is not set yet
5. Tap a character slot
6. Tap the filter icon
7. Tap Male
8. Tap Indigenous
9. Tap the checkmark
10. Check the result

Result:
Only the Create my character tile and blank space are shown, with no message or clear option.
摘要：篩選無結果時只顯示 Create my character 與空白，無任何提示。
{16.9.0_amd42_filter.jpg} {16.9.0_amd42_blank_result.jpg}

Expect Result:
An empty state says no characters match and offers to clear the filter (No sheet describes this).
摘要：應顯示無符合角色的空狀態並提供清除篩選（規格未定義）。

[AI Recommendation]
Title: No characters match
Body: Try removing a filter to see more characters.
Button: Clear filters

Note:
Device: iPhone 17 Air / iOS 26.2.1
Spec Link: AI Mini Drama Design spec, Characters: Flow, Create my character, Filter, Error board - https://www.figma.com/design/dZk5HLzZTdcZwWwvN9aZfZ/AI-Mini-Drama?node-id=2811-105834
<Claude Reviewed>
AI-Mini-Drama-P23-03.qa_note: Spec addition (TC-288, user QA rule 8: data-driven facets — an empty result is shown clearly). The Ethnicity facets themselves are fine: 8 values that match the 189-card library exactly (no Southeast Asian or Mixed cards exist, so their absence is correct), and each value alone returns only matching cards. The gap is the empty result: Male + Indigenous (the only Indigenous card is female) leaves only the 「Create my character」 tile and blank space — no 'No characters match' text and no Clear action. Design's Filter frames give no empty-state copy, so PM/Design must define it; the strings below are a suggestion.

AI-Mini-Drama-P23-04.title: Create my character description runs under the expand icon
AI-Mini-Drama-P23-04.short: PDR-I 16.9.0 - [AIAgent][UI] AI Mini Drama: Create my character description text runs under the expand icon
AI-Mini-Drama-P23-04.desc:
Repro Steps:
1. Launch the APP
2. Tap AI Mini Drama on the Launcher
3. Tap History
4. Tap a drama whose cast is not set yet
5. Tap a character slot
6. Tap Create my character
7. Type a description of 600+ characters
8. Drag up inside the description
9. Check the result

Result:
The description text is not inset from the expand icon; words are drawn under the icon.
摘要：描述文字未避開展開圖示，捲動後文字與圖示重疊。
{16.9.0_amd43_scrolled.jpg} {16.9.0_amd43_overlap_zoom.jpg}

Expect Result:
The text keeps clear of the expand icon at every scroll position.
摘要：任何捲動位置文字都不應與展開圖示重疊。

Note:
Device: iPhone 17 Air / iOS 26.2.1
Spec Link: AI Mini Drama Design spec, Characters: Flow, Create my character, Filter, Error board - https://www.figma.com/design/dZk5HLzZTdcZwWwvN9aZfZ/AI-Mini-Drama?node-id=2811-90468
<Claude Reviewed>
AI-Mini-Drama-P23-04.qa_note: Off-case observation O-6, seen on passing case TC-125 (long description, 656 characters). The description text is not inset from the expand icon in the field's top-right corner: on the first line 「fluffy」 ends right at the icon, and after scrolling, 「ears」 is drawn underneath it (zoomed capture). User QA rule 8: entered text never overlaps adjacent controls. No log (layout only).

AI-Mini-Drama-P23-05.title: AI Mini Drama strings stay English in Traditional Chinese and Japanese
AI-Mini-Drama-P23-05.short: PDR-I 16.9.0 - [AIAgent][UI] AI Mini Drama: Feature strings stay English in Traditional Chinese and Japanese
AI-Mini-Drama-P23-05.desc:
Repro Steps:
1. Open iOS Settings
2. Tap PowerDirector
3. Tap Language
4. Tap 繁體中文
5. Launch the APP
6. Tap AI 短劇 on the Launcher
7. Tap After Closing
8. Tap Make my version
9. Check the result

Result:
AI Mini Drama strings stay English while shared strings are translated, so dialogs mix languages.
摘要：AI 短劇功能文字未翻譯，與已翻譯的共用文字混雜在同一畫面。
{16.9.0_amd44_cht_entry.jpg} {16.9.0_amd44_cht_leave_dialog.jpg} {16.9.0_amd44_jpn_format_card.jpg} {16.9.0_amd44_jpn_leave_dialog.jpg}

Expect Result:
Every AI Mini Drama string is shown in the app language (Traditional Chinese / Japanese).
摘要：AI 短劇所有文字應以 App 語言（繁體中文/日文）顯示。

Note:
Device: iPhone 17 Air / iOS 26.2.1
Spec Link: AI Mini Drama Design spec, AI Mini Drama home page / Custom detail / Chat room detail board - https://www.figma.com/design/dZk5HLzZTdcZwWwvN9aZfZ/AI-Mini-Drama?node-id=116-7873
<Claude Reviewed>
AI-Mini-Drama-P23-05.qa_note: TC-276 (CHT) and TC-277 (JPN) text tours, the app started with device.ts launch --lang zh-Hant / ja (launch arguments, the same per-app language the Repro Steps set through iOS Settings). The shared strings are localized (生成, 更多/その他, 刪除, 重新命名, 女性/男性, 離開/退出 …) but every AI Mini Drama feature string stays English: entry 'Hi, I'm your AI Drama Assistant', 'Create Your Drama', 'Start from a template', 'Make my version', the format card 'What format would you like for your video?' / '1. Video language' / '2. Captions', 'Leave this chat?' and 'Leave without finishing?' dialogs (buttons half localized: 「離開」 + 'Keep choosing'), History info tip, 'Characters Result', 'Create storyboard', 'Storyboard Preview', 'Video length', 'Choose Character', 'Create my character', 'AI Suggestion', 'Ethnicity*' and every ethnicity, filter 'My characters only'. Template names are localized in JPN but English in CHT; category names English in both. O-2: the chat's fixed prompts stay English with the app in Japanese. Generated story content language is a separate ticket (DRI261894P0046, still reproduces, TC-187). Japanese template names no longer truncate (DRI261896P0022 not reproduced). Owner RD (user decision 2026-10-21, was PC-Doc): the strings are not wired to the translation table. Spec Link: the home page board that holds the entry strings (R-003); there is no localization board.
